attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Mississippi state income tax per Form 80-105. Mississippi uses a simple progressive tax system: 0% on first $10,000 of taxable income, 4.4% on income above $10,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($2,300 Single/MFS, $4,600 MFJ, $3,400 HOH), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "MISSISSIPPI FORM 80-105 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ms_agi xdef 0 /result.ms_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.ms_bracket_2_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MS tax MFJ; Calculate MS tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.ms_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto ms_standard_deduction_mfj /result.ms_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.ms_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ms_agi result.ms_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.ms_taxable_income xdef " MS Taxable Income: $" result.ms_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ms_taxable_income ms_zero_bracket f> if 0 /result.ms_bracket_1_tax xdef result.ms_taxable_income ms_zero_bracket f- ms_tax_rate f* /result.ms_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$10,000): $0.00" job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (4.4% above $10,000): $" result.ms_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else 0 /result.ms_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (0% on $0-$" result.ms_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $0.00" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif result.ms_bracket_1_tax result.ms_bracket_2_tax f+ /result.ms_tax xdef " Total MS Tax: $" result.ms_tax cvs strconcat " (Mississippi Form 80-105)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
